title: Prefill profile manifest, schema version 1
description: Shape of profile.json. The parser also rejects duplicate keys (including escaped spellings of the same key), manifests larger than 8192 bytes, and labels that contain C0/C1 control characters or only white space. JSON Schema cannot express those rules alone.

schemaVersion.description: Must be 1. Other values are rejected, not migrated.

id.description: Must equal the profile directory name and the canonical directory basename.

name.description: Display label. Unicode is allowed; controls and blank values are rejected.

description.description: Display label. Unicode is allowed; controls and blank values are rejected.
